name: PyDFT Workbench
author: Acxel Orozco
description: Educational pydft workbench for QAH. Detects pydft from a Wheel Plugin Manager vendor set, runs a CO/STO-3G Kohn-Sham demo and reports energy, HOMO/LUMO, gap, SCF iterations and timing.
dependency_note: Inject pydft from Wheel Plugin Manager (Package: pydft, Target: global), then press Detect dependencies.
